statement_summary: Security Officer and Privacy Officer designated in writing
Annual risk analysis with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
HIPAA sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
No BAA, no ePHI; MSP subcontractor BAAs checked yearly
Annual independent evaluation
Six-year retention of security documentation
Annual policy review; policies available to staff
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Unique accounts; no shared or generic accounts
Role-based least privilege with written approval
MFA everywhere including MSP-held administrator logins
Termination checklist completed by the last day
Monthly account reconciliation; quarterly role check
10-minute device lock; 15-minute EHR timeout; no exemptions
Emergency EHR administrator access
Named MSP and vendor accounts with MFA; yearly technician list
Password length; yearly Wi-Fi password change
Minimum necessary look-ups only
No ePHI in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Training at hire and yearly; phishing simulations
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Ransomware runbook kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Four-factor breach risk assessment; discovery date recorded
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged under BAA
Ransom payment only with approvals and OFAC check
Business associate incident reports logged and handled
Annual tabletop exercise with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Restricted data only in approved systems
Device and ePHI inventory
New tools approved and under BAA before receiving Restricted data
Approved AI tools only
90-day immutable backup versions; quarterly restore test
Wipe or certified destruction with records
Retention of medical records and security documents
